accountId.title: Account Id
accountId.description: Salesforce Id of a specific Account (starts with 001), e.g. the record the user is viewing.

accountName.title: Account Name
accountName.description: Full or partial account name to search for, e.g. Acme.

accountType.title: Type
accountType.description: Only return accounts of this type, e.g. Prospect, Customer - Direct, Customer - Channel.

billingState.title: Billing State
billingState.description: Only return accounts billed in this US state, as the full state name, e.g. California.

industry.title: Industry
industry.description: Only return accounts in this industry, e.g. Finance, Technology, Healthcare, Retail, Energy.

maxAnnualRevenue.title: Maximum Annual Revenue
maxAnnualRevenue.description: Only return accounts with annual revenue at or below this amount in US dollars.

maxResults.title: Max Results
maxResults.description: Maximum number of accounts to return (default 10, at most 25).

minAnnualRevenue.title: Minimum Annual Revenue
minAnnualRevenue.description: Only return accounts with annual revenue at or above this amount in US dollars, e.g. 50000000 for 50M.

rating.title: Rating
rating.description: Only return accounts with this rating. Allowed values: Hot, Warm, Cold.
